result.instructions: VRoid Studio MCP. Tool names and arguments are English. Call vroid_help('overview') before a complex task; vroid_help supports lang=en|fr|ja|zh-CN. VRoid Studio must be running with the bridge loaded. Only one model can be open at a time. Call vroid_status first. Save before vroid_main_menu, vroid_open or vroid_create. For visual work, use vroid_screenshot. For preset discovery, use vroid_preset_cache_search before applying presets. For sequences, use vroid_batch (up to 200 sequential operations, no automatic rollback). Do not assume that one preset replaces only one slot: whole outfits can replace several slots; verify with vroid_list_groups. Thumbnail generation strips all clothes, underwear and hair except the tested item. An English Agent Reference is exposed as MCP resources: vroid://agent/reference (full), plus vroid://agent/start, face, hairstyle, body, outfit, accessories, look, physical, presets, tools, workflows and troubleshooting. Read only the section needed; tools/list stays the authoritative schema list. MCP prompts: start (open a working session), character (build a character from a description), export_vrm (full/balanced/light VRM export), help. Reply in the user's language; never overwrite the user's .vroid file or discard changes without asking.

content.text:
<!-- lang=en topic=export -->
# VRM export

`vroid_export_vrm` uses VRoid's own exporter, without clicks or a file dialog. The open model is
not modified.

    vroid_export_vrm path=D:\out\model.vrm version=1 delete_transparent=true hair=50 hair_bones=50

- `path` is required; `.vrm` is appended when missing.
- `version`: `1` = VRM 1.0 (default), `0` = VRM 0.x.
- `delete_transparent` (default `true`) = VRoid's **Delete Transparent Meshes**.
- `hair_smoothness`, `hair`, `face`, `body`, `outfit`: polygon reduction 0..100.
- `material_mode`: 0 = Default, 1 = 2 materials, 2 = 8, 3 = 12.
- `combine_hair` (default `true`) = Combine Hair Mesh.
- `texture_mode`: 0 = Original, 1 = Shrunk. Shrunk is only accepted with `material_mode=0`.
- `atlas_resolution` with material reduction: 0 = 4096, 1 = 2048.
- `hair_bones`: Reduce Bones / Hair, 0..100.
- The export opens VRoid's export screen and takes about 10-40 s; it returns to the editor
  afterwards by default. `leave=false` leaves the export screen open for manual inspection.

Options refused by VRoid are reported in `warnings`; the response also contains the final
`settings`, byte size and elapsed time. The `.vroid` file itself is not changed, so save before
exporting only if you also want to keep model edits.

`vroid_export_vrm_options` opens the same screen and returns its current settings and the
available material/texture/atlas choices. It closes the screen by default (`leave=true`); use
`leave=false` only when you want to inspect it and continue manually.
